name: SafeOrStolen AI
description: AI-powered consumer protection platform. SafeOrStolen AI is a conversational verification assistant powered by Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet that verifies whether secondhand items are stolen by checking IMEI numbers, VIN numbers, serial numbers, and firearm serial numbers against 100+ law enforcement, insurance, and carrier databases. Includes AI smart identifier detection, AI scam scoring, AI marketplace URL analysis, and AI visual OCR. 2 free checks, results in 3 seconds. Then $0.99/check or $10/month unlimited.
softwareRequirements: Modern web browser; AI features powered by Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet via Lovable AI Gateway

offers.name: Unlimited Monthly
offers.description: $10/month unlimited verifications — all item types, cancel anytime

featureList: IMEI phone verification against GSMA Device Registry and carrier blacklists (AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile)
VIN vehicle theft status verification via NICB and NHTSA
Firearm serial number verification via ATF, FBI NCIC (7M+ stolen firearms), HotGunz (32,000+), all 50 state police databases
Bicycle serial number verification via BikeIndex (700K+ registered bikes)
Electronics and laptop serial number checks
License plate lookup for all 50 US states

Marketplace URL Analyzer — paste any listing URL from Facebook Marketplace, eBay, Craigslist, OfferUp, Mercari, or Poshmark to auto-extract identifiers and check stolen databases (unique feature, no competitor offers this)
AI-powered scam detector with 0-100 risk scoring
Progressive Web App with barcode scanning for iOS and Android
